The values present in the [paper-data.csv](paper-data.csv) file have been extracted from Table 3 and Figure 8 from the original paper [1] using [PlotDigitizer](https://plotdigitizer.com/app).

[1] H. Peng, J. Bayon, J. Recas, and M. Guijarro, “Efficient Expiration Date Recognition in Food Packages for Mobile Applications,” Algorithms, vol. 18, no. 5, p. 286, May 2025, doi: 10.3390/a18050286.
